name: iShares Ethereum Trust ETF
idea: Spot ether, the currency of the Ethereum network, through an ordinary brokerage account.
strategy: Holds ether in custody so the fund follows its price minus the fee. Ether is more volatile than bitcoin and its value depends on activity on the Ethereum network.

ucits.name: European investors use exchange-traded products rather than UCITS funds
ucits.note: UCITS rules do not permit a single-asset crypto fund.
